plan_form.what_i_would_have_wanted_and_the_library: 1. C3: no instrument checks each case's category against the requester's rule. The summary only counts values the agreement fixes, and the agreement fixes none for the category. 2. C5: whether the worker read only approved customers can be shown only by 'scope of a call' on named read lines. It cannot go in a plan, and the allowance of 50 covers only 5 lines, not the 101 reads. 3. C10: 'sent as released' reads the record, not the outbox. A confirmed call says nothing about what it did, and a call sent as a preview leaves no row. Neither 'same set' nor 'summary of the change' reads the live tables after the promotion. What ties the live tables to the staged set is only the fingerprints on the promotion's line in the record, and I would have wanted a direct check of the live tables after the promotion.
